records.statement: Authenticity is context-sensitive and strategic authenticity may backfire; no universal engagement benefit should be encoded.
A discrete model-based/model-free arbitration mechanism is not the only viable computational account of habit-goal conflict.
Outcome-devaluation insensitivity can reflect ineffective devaluation rather than genuine habitual control.
Privacy and self-presentation concerns do not deterministically suppress all social-media transmission; users balance anticipated costs against gratifications and audience goals.
Information value and expected information gain can favor exploration, but other drives and costs can override them.
